title: Student Privacy & Campus Surveillance Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request information about campus surveillance systems and student data collection. Protect your privacy rights as a student.
description: A comprehensive letter template for students to formally request information about campus surveillance practices, data collection policies, and monitoring systems affecting their privacy rights on campus.

sections.heading: Subject and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information Regarding Student Privacy and Campus Surveillance Practices

Dear [Administrator Name],

I am writing as a currently enrolled student to formally request information about the surveillance systems, data collection practices, and privacy policies that affect students on campus. Under the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) and applicable state privacy laws, I believe I have the right to understand how my personal information and activities are monitored and recorded.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following information:

1. SURVEILLANCE SYSTEMS:
- Complete list of all surveillance cameras, their locations, and coverage areas
- Recording schedules and data retention periods for video surveillance
- Who has access to surveillance footage and under what circumstances
- Policies governing the use of surveillance data

2. DIGITAL MONITORING:
- Information about network monitoring on campus Wi-Fi systems
- Details about any software used to monitor student computer activity
- Policies regarding digital proctoring and remote learning surveillance
- Any tracking of student device usage or internet browsing

3. DATA COLLECTION PRACTICES:
- Types of personal data collected beyond academic records
- Third-party companies with access to student data
- Data sharing agreements with external organizations
- Student rights regarding data access, correction, and deletion

sections.heading: Privacy Concerns and Rights
sections.content:
As a student, I am particularly concerned about:

- The extent of monitoring in dormitories, common areas, and academic spaces
- Whether facial recognition or other biometric technologies are in use
- How long personal data is retained and when it is deleted
- My rights to opt-out of non-essential data collection
- Procedures for reporting privacy violations or concerns

I would also like to understand the legal basis for each type of data collection and surveillance, and whether students were consulted before implementing these systems.

sections.heading: Request for Documentation
sections.content:
Please provide copies of:

- Current privacy policies affecting students
- Surveillance and monitoring policies
- Data retention and deletion schedules
- Any privacy impact assessments conducted
- Vendor agreements related to student data processing
- Procedures for students to access or correct their personal information

I understand that some information may need to be redacted for security purposes, but I request maximum transparency regarding policies and practices that affect student privacy.

sections.heading: Timeline and Closing
sections.content:
I would appreciate a response within 30 days of receiving this letter, as is standard for privacy-related requests. If you need additional time to compile this information, please let me know the expected timeline.

I am committed to working collaboratively to ensure that student privacy rights are respected while maintaining necessary security measures. If you would like to discuss this request or schedule a meeting, please contact me at [your email] or [your phone number].

Thank you for your attention to this important matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Student ID Number]
